info.name: The Watch Box (WatchSphere) - Mobile App & Admin API Collection
info.description:
# The Watch Box (WatchSphere) API Collection

Comprehensive Postman collection and API reference designed specifically for **The Watch Box** luxury watch marketplace mobile application (Flutter) and Admin Management dashboard.

### Environment Variables
- **`baseUrl`**: API base URL (Default: `http://localhost:4000`)
- **`accessToken`**: Customer JWT access token
- **`refreshToken`**: Customer JWT refresh token
- **`adminToken`**: Admin JWT token
- **`listingId`**: Target watch listing ID
- **`watchModelId`**: Target watch model ID
- **`savedSearchId`**: User saved search ID
- **`watchlistId`**: User watchlist ID
- **`notificationId`**: User notification alert ID
- **`orderId`**: Peer order ID
- **`planId`**: Subscription plan ID
